summary: The scene delivers beat b5 precisely, letting the Grippewelle carry Stettler through a day that swallows his planned trip to Rieder, but it never clearly stages the required shift of stettler:knowledge_selbstanzeige_verzoegert from unaware to suspects.

issues.unit: Man hatte dort also ebenfalls bis in die Nacht gearbeitet
issues.fix_hint: Give Stettler a thought, even a fragmentary one, that ties the lit window at Rieder's office to his own undelivered confession, so his 'suspects' (since ch2) reads as a question forming on the page rather than a neutral observation about a busy neighbour.
